title: LACO — Adaptive Latent Communication for Collaborative Driving
summary_zh: 把 跨 agent KV cache 共享 從 LLM 多 agent 帶到協作駕駛 VLA 的訓練自由方法。獨立命名 agent 身份混淆（接收方對他車潛在狀態過度關注導致表徵糾纏），並以三算子處理：ILD 在 KV cache 內做潛在深思、CHSA 以逐 token 顯著度 Top-K 保留 30% token、SSKD 只傳前 ~10% 淺層。關鍵在於其身份混淆的解法是 層截斷式規避（不共享深層），而非對被重用狀態的減法式去污染，且選擇屬發送端重要性而非接收方決策相關性。CARLA 閉環：駕駛分數 26.68→35.48，延遲相對語言 ~18×、酬載相對視覺 −40~90%。明確引用 KVCOMM。
summary_en: A training-free method that carries cross-agent KV-cache sharing from LLM multi-agent systems to collaborative-driving VLAs. It independently names agent identity confusion (the receiver over-attends to another vehicle's latent states, entangling representations) and addresses it with three operators: ILD does latent deliberation inside the KV cache, CHSA keeps 30% of tokens by per-token saliency Top-K, and SSKD transmits only the first ~10% shallow layers. Crucially its identity-confusion fix is layer-truncation avoidance (do not share deep layers), not subtractive decontamination of reused states, and its selection is sender-side importance rather than receiver-decision relevance. CARLA closed-loop: driving score 26.68→35.48, ~18× latency reduction vs language and 40–90% smaller payload vs visual sharing. Explicitly cites KVCOMM.
